usageNotes: Triggers an async refresh of the cached task list from one or more Proxmox remotes registered in PDM. Returns a UPID string — poll the resulting task to know when the cache is current before querying remote tasks. Omitting the `remotes` body field refreshes all remotes the authenticated user has `Resource.Modify` permission on; supplying a list restricts the refresh to exactly those remotes (each must grant that privilege).

examples.summary: Refresh tasks for two specific remotes

tips: With an empty body `{}`, the endpoint silently skips any remote the user lacks Resource.Modify on — no error is raised, those remotes are simply excluded.
The returned UPID encodes the PDM node, PID, and start time; use it with the PDM task-status endpoint to detect completion before consuming the refreshed data.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), so automation scripts can trigger refreshes without an interactive session.
